"""Cluster-internal origin proxy, central barrier and raw trial recorder."""
import argparse
import collections
import http.client
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess
import threading
import time
import traceback
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from common import BodyCounter, file_sha, save, validate_cohort

ROOT = pathlib.Path('/e11')
LOCK = threading.RLock()
STATE = dict(workers={}, trial=None, boot=time.time(), counters=BodyCounter(), active_proxy=0, stop=False)
NODES = ['cpu-1', 'cpu-2', 'etri-001']


def nic_info():
    out = {}
    for p in pathlib.Path('/host-sys/class/net').glob('*'):
        fields = {}
        for name in ['operstate', 'speed', 'duplex', 'mtu', 'statistics/rx_bytes', 'statistics/tx_bytes']:
            try:
                fields[name] = (p/name).read_text().strip()
            except OSError as e:
                fields[name] = type(e).__name__
        out[p.name] = fields
    return out


def public_state():
    with LOCK:
        t = STATE['trial']
        return dict(workers=STATE['workers'], trial=None if t is None else
                    {k: v for k, v in t.items() if k not in ['commands', 'counter']},
                    origin_nics=nic_info())


def finish_trial(trial):
    try:
        deadline = time.monotonic()+1800
        while True:
            with LOCK:
                if set(trial['ready']) == set(NODES) and not STATE['active_proxy']:
                    trial['preparation_origin'] = STATE['counters'].snapshot()
                    STATE['counters'] = BodyCounter()
                    trial['release_mono'] = time.monotonic()
                    trial['release_utc'] = time.time()
                    trial['origin_nics_before'] = nic_info()
                    break
                if trial['results']:
                    raise RuntimeError('worker failed before barrier')
            if time.monotonic() > deadline:
                raise TimeoutError('ready barrier timed out')
            time.sleep(.02)
        while True:
            with LOCK:
                if set(trial['results']) == set(NODES) and not STATE['active_proxy']:
                    trial['status'] = 'completed'
                    trial['origin'] = STATE['counters'].snapshot()
                    trial['origin_nics_after'] = nic_info()
                    trial['metrics'] = validate_cohort(trial)
                    break
            if time.monotonic() > deadline:
                raise TimeoutError('cohort completion timed out')
            time.sleep(.02)
    except BaseException:
        with LOCK:
            trial['status'] = 'failed'
            trial['error'] = traceback.format_exc()
            trial['origin'] = STATE['counters'].snapshot()
    finally:
        with LOCK:
            trial['finished_utc'] = time.time()
            save(ROOT/'runs'/trial['trial']/'cohort.json',
                 {k: v for k, v in trial.items() if k != 'commands'})


class Admin(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *args):
        pass

    def reply(self, obj, status=200):
        raw = json.dumps(obj).encode()
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(raw)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(raw)

    def do_GET(self):
        path = urlsplit(self.path).path
        if path == '/status':
            return self.reply(public_state())
        if path in ['/assets/onggi', '/inputs.json']:
            p = ROOT/('onggi' if path.startswith('/assets/') else 'inputs.json')
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header('Content-Length', str(p.stat().st_size))
            self.end_headers()
            with p.open('rb') as f:
                while b := f.read(1 << 20):
                    self.wfile.write(b)
            return
        if path.startswith('/command/'):
            node = path.rsplit('/', 1)[1]
            with LOCK:
                trial = STATE['trial']
                cmd = dict(stop=True) if STATE['stop'] else trial['commands'].get(node) if trial else None
            return self.reply(cmd)
        if path.startswith('/barrier/'):
            name = path.rsplit('/', 1)[1]
            with LOCK:
                t = STATE['trial']
                return self.reply(dict(released=bool(t and t['trial'] == name and 'release_mono' in t),
                                       failed=bool(t and t['trial'] == name and t['status'] == 'failed')))
        return self.reply(dict(error='unknown route'), 404)

    def do_POST(self):
        data = json.loads(self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', '0'))))
        path = self.path
        with LOCK:
            if path == '/stop':
                STATE['stop'] = True
            elif path == '/shutdown':
                STATE['stop'] = True
                threading.Thread(target=self.server.shutdown,daemon=True).start()
            elif path == '/register':
                assert data['node'] in NODES
                STATE['workers'][data['node']] = data
                save(ROOT/'workers.json', STATE['workers'])
            elif path == '/cohort/start':
                assert set(STATE['workers']) == set(NODES)
                old = STATE['trial']
                assert not old or old['status'] in ['completed', 'failed']
                assert data['arm'] in ['store', 'peer'] and data['stratum'] in ['empty', 'one-seed']
                name = data['trial']
                assert name.replace('-', '').isalnum() and not (ROOT/'runs'/name).exists()
                trial = dict(data, nodes=NODES, status='preparing', ready={}, results={},
                             started={}, pulled={}, created_utc=time.time(), commands={})
                peers = {n: 'http://'+STATE['workers'][n]['ip']+':7071' for n in NODES}
                for n in NODES:
                    trial['commands'][n] = dict(data, peers=[u for nn,u in peers.items() if nn != n],
                                                seed=(n == NODES[0]))
                STATE['trial'] = trial
                STATE['counters'] = BodyCounter()
                threading.Thread(target=finish_trial, args=(trial,), daemon=True).start()
            elif path in ['/ready', '/started', '/pulled', '/result']:
                t = STATE['trial']
                assert t and data['trial'] == t['trial'] and data['node'] in NODES
                node = data['node']
                if path == '/ready':
                    assert node not in t['ready']
                    t['ready'][node] = data
                elif path == '/started':
                    assert 'release_mono' in t and node not in t['started']
                    t['started'][node] = time.monotonic()
                elif path == '/pulled':
                    assert node not in t['pulled']
                    t['pulled'][node] = time.monotonic()
                else:
                    assert node not in t['results']
                    t['results'][node] = data
            else:
                return self.reply(dict(error='unknown route'), 404)
        self.reply(dict(ok=True))


class Proxy(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = 'HTTP/1.1'

    def log_message(self, *args):
        pass

    def do_HEAD(self):
        self.forward()

    def do_GET(self):
        self.forward()

    def forward(self):
        # Workers only READ the immutable source. Reject mutation at the proxy.
        conn = http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1', 7070, timeout=180)
        count = 0
        status = 502
        with LOCK:
            STATE['active_proxy'] += 1
            counter = STATE['counters']
            trial = STATE['trial']
            trial_id = trial['trial'] if trial else 'bootstrap'
        try:
            headers = {k: v for k,v in self.headers.items() if k.lower() not in ['connection', 'proxy-connection']}
            conn.request(self.command, self.path, headers=headers)
            response = conn.getresponse()
            status = response.status
            self.send_response(status)
            for k,v in response.getheaders():
                if k.lower() not in ['connection', 'transfer-encoding', 'server', 'date']:
                    self.send_header(k,v)
            self.send_header('Connection', 'close')
            self.end_headers()
            if self.command != 'HEAD':
                while b := response.read(1 << 20):
                    self.wfile.write(b)
                    count += len(b)
        finally:
            conn.close()
            counter.record(self.path, count, status)
            record = dict(utc=time.time(), trial=trial_id, method=self.command,
                          path=self.path, status=status, body_bytes=count, client=self.client_address[0])
            with LOCK:
                with (ROOT/'origin-requests.jsonl').open('a') as f:
                    f.write(json.dumps(record)+'\n')
                STATE['active_proxy'] -= 1
            self.close_connection = True


def main():
    ROOT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    # Dedicated disposable test identity, same public fixture credentials as CI.
    gateway = subprocess.Popen([str(ROOT/'versitygw'), '--access', 'onggitest',
        '--secret', 'onggitestsecret', '--port', '127.0.0.1:7070', 'posix', '/data'],
        stdout=open(ROOT/'gateway.log','ab'), stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    threading.Thread(target=ThreadingHTTPServer(('0.0.0.0',9000),Proxy).serve_forever,daemon=True).start()
    try:
        ThreadingHTTPServer(('0.0.0.0',9010),Admin).serve_forever()
    finally:
        gateway.terminate()
        gateway.wait(timeout=20)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""One CPU-only Job per node; verified files and disposable per-trial inodes."""
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
import traceback
import urllib.request

from common import file_sha, save
from origin import nic_info

ROOT = pathlib.Path('/work')
ADMIN = os.environ['E11_ADMIN'].rstrip('/')
STORE = os.environ['E11_STORE']
NODE = os.environ['NODE_NAME']
BIN = ROOT/'onggi'
ENV = dict(os.environ, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID='onggitest', AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY='onggitestsecret',
           GOMAXPROCS='2', GOMEMLIMIT='2500MiB')


def api(path, data=None):
    request = urllib.request.Request(ADMIN+path, data=None if data is None else json.dumps(data).encode(),
                                     headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
        return json.load(response)


def run(args, folder, stem):
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    begin = time.monotonic()
    p = subprocess.run([str(BIN)]+args, env=ENV, capture_output=True, timeout=1200)
    elapsed = time.monotonic()-begin
    (folder/(stem+'.stdout')).write_bytes(p.stdout)
    (folder/(stem+'.stderr')).write_bytes(p.stderr)
    return dict(returncode=p.returncode, wall_s=elapsed, argv=args,
                stdout=p.stdout.decode(errors='replace'), stderr=p.stderr.decode(errors='replace'))


def verify(folder, artifact):
    start = time.monotonic()
    actual = []
    for item in artifact['files']:
        p = folder/item['path']
        assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink(), str(p)
        actual.append(dict(path=item['path'], bytes=p.stat().st_size, sha256=file_sha(p)))
    expected = sorted(artifact['files'],key=lambda x:x['path'])
    actual.sort(key=lambda x:x['path'])
    assert actual == expected, 'output SHA/size mismatch'
    assert sorted(p.relative_to(folder).as_posix() for p in folder.rglob('*') if p.is_file()) == [p['path'] for p in expected]
    return dict(hashes_match=True, files=actual, hash_validation_s=time.monotonic()-start)


def consumable(folder, inputs):
    start = time.monotonic()
    # cp creates independent inodes even when reflinks are available.
    subprocess.run(['cp','-a','--reflink=auto',str(ROOT/'base'),str(folder)],check=True)
    for item in inputs['artifacts']['base']['files']:
        src, dst = ROOT/'base'/item['path'], folder/item['path']
        assert src.stat().st_ino != dst.stat().st_ino
        assert src.stat().st_size == dst.stat().st_size
    return time.monotonic()-start


def init_cache(folder, inputs):
    for item in inputs['store_config']:
        p = folder/item['path']
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        raw = base64.b64decode(item['base64'])
        assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == item['sha256']
        p.write_bytes(raw)


def trial(command, inputs):
    name = command['trial']
    work = ROOT/'runs'/name
    work.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    result = dict(node=NODE, trial=name, status='failed', hashes_match=False,
                  command=command, utc=time.time(), pod_uid=os.environ['POD_UID'])
    peer = None
    try:
        copy_s = consumable(work/'base',inputs)
        cache = work/'cache'
        if command['stratum'] == 'one-seed' and command['seed']:
            shutil.copytree(ROOT/'seed-cache',cache)
        else:
            init_cache(cache,inputs)
        cache_files = [dict(path=p.relative_to(cache).as_posix(),bytes=p.stat().st_size,sha256=file_sha(p))
                       for p in cache.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
        if command['arm'] == 'peer':
            peer = subprocess.Popen([str(BIN),'peer','serve','--cache',str(cache),
                '--listen',':7071','--refresh','1h'],env=ENV,
                stdout=open(work/'peer.log','ab'),stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
            deadline = time.monotonic()+30
            while True:
                try:
                    req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:7071/v1/has',data=b'',method='POST')
                    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=2) as r:
                        assert r.read() == b''
                    break
                except OSError:
                    assert peer.poll() is None and time.monotonic()<deadline
                    time.sleep(.05)
        ready = dict(node=NODE,trial=name,copy_s=copy_s,cache_before=cache_files,
                     nics=nic_info(),ready_utc=time.time())
        save(work/'ready.json',ready)
        api('/ready',ready)
        while True:
            barrier=api('/barrier/'+name)
            if barrier['failed']:
                raise RuntimeError('central barrier failed')
            if barrier['released']:
                break
            time.sleep(.01)
        api('/started',dict(node=NODE,trial=name))
        args=['pull','--store',STORE,'--workers','2','--json','--cache',str(cache),
              '--base',inputs['artifacts']['base']['manifest'],'--base-dir',str(work/'base')]
        if command['arm'] == 'peer':
            args += ['--peers',','.join(command['peers'])]
        args += [inputs['artifacts']['target']['manifest'],str(work/'out')]
        pulled=run(args,work,'pull')
        # Completion marker precedes full-file SHA work; receipt uses one central monotonic clock.
        api('/pulled',dict(node=NODE,trial=name,returncode=pulled['returncode']))
        result.update(pulled, pull_s=pulled['wall_s'], nics_after=nic_info())
        assert pulled['returncode'] == 0, pulled['stderr']
        report=json.loads(pulled['stdout'])
        assert report['manifest'] == inputs['artifacts']['target']['manifest']
        result.update(report)
        result.update(verify(work/'out',inputs['artifacts']['target']))
        assert result['stats']['base'] == inputs['artifacts']['base']['manifest']
        result['status']='completed'
    except BaseException:
        result['error']=traceback.format_exc()
    finally:
        if peer:
            peer.terminate()
            peer.wait(timeout=20)
        save(work/'result.json',result)
        api('/result',result)
        # Delete only owned trial bulk payloads AFTER evidence is written and acknowledged.
        for label in ['base','out','cache']:
            target=(work/label).resolve()
            assert target.is_relative_to((ROOT/'runs').resolve()) and target != ROOT/'runs'
            if target.exists():
                shutil.rmtree(target)
    if result['status'] != 'completed':
        raise RuntimeError(result.get('error','trial failed'))


def main():
    ROOT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(ADMIN+'/inputs.json',timeout=30) as r:
        inputs=json.load(r)
    save(ROOT/'inputs.json',inputs)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(ADMIN+'/assets/onggi',timeout=60) as r, BIN.open('wb') as f:
        shutil.copyfileobj(r,f)
    BIN.chmod(0o755)
    assert file_sha(BIN) == inputs['tools']['onggi']['sha256']
    bootstrap=run(['pull','--store',STORE,'--workers','2','--json',
                   inputs['artifacts']['base']['manifest'],str(ROOT/'base')],ROOT,'bootstrap')
    assert bootstrap['returncode']==0,bootstrap['stderr']
    bootstrap.update(verify(ROOT/'base',inputs['artifacts']['base']))
    seed=None
    if NODE=='cpu-1':
        seed_copy=consumable(ROOT/'seed-base',inputs)
        seed=run(['pull','--store',STORE,'--workers','2','--json','--cache',str(ROOT/'seed-cache'),
                  '--base',inputs['artifacts']['base']['manifest'],'--base-dir',str(ROOT/'seed-base'),
                  inputs['artifacts']['target']['manifest'],str(ROOT/'seed-out')],ROOT,'seed')
        assert seed['returncode']==0,seed['stderr']
        seed.update(verify(ROOT/'seed-out',inputs['artifacts']['target']))
        seed['copy_s']=seed_copy
        shutil.rmtree(ROOT/'seed-out')
        if (ROOT/'seed-base').exists():
            shutil.rmtree(ROOT/'seed-base')
    registration=dict(node=NODE,ip=os.environ['POD_IP'],pod_uid=os.environ['POD_UID'],
        bootstrap=bootstrap,seed=seed,nics=nic_info(),python=os.sys.version,
        device_files=[p.name for p in pathlib.Path('/dev').iterdir() if any(x in p.name.lower() for x in ['rbln','furiosa','rngd','nvidia'])],
        binary_sha256=file_sha(BIN))
    assert not registration['device_files']
    save(ROOT/'registration.json',registration)
    api('/register',registration)
    last=None
    while True:
        command=api('/command/'+NODE)
        if command and command.get('stop'):
            return
        if command and command['trial']!=last:
            trial(command,inputs)
            last=command['trial']
        time.sleep(.2)


if __name__=='__main__':
    main()
